value.0: AA-181920 is a large droid from the depths of the desert. Once a drilling droid, he was abandoned when the caves he was drilling in collapsed, killing everyone inside. Unsure of his current directive or who is owner is, he stands in the corner of anchorhead and does nothing.

These small droids are widespread.  The term "utility droid" is used for many different models that vary widely in form and function. Some of them, particularly the Duwani Mechanicals models, were at times referred as "astromech droids." 

Some models are used for advanced applied physics functions such as starship repair, astrogation, and even computer slicing and programming. Others perform more menial tasks such as janitorial duties and waste disposal.

Almost all are under one meter tall. They arre equipped either with wheeled legs or small repulsorlift generators for movement.

This oddly cheery Arkanian man carries himself with the calm confidence of an elder, despite looking hardly halfway into his twenties. He regards you with a friendly and serene smile, seemingly unafraid of the unknowns of the world around him. His nose is pointed but small, his jawline pronounced and with cheekbones just as defined. His eyes are normal for an Arkanian; pure white without pupils.

He wears loose-fitting tunics that are either covering a suit of fur armour or simply his bare chest, with tight pants that are met at the top of his calves by leather boots. On his back and belt are a great many trinkets, vials and scrolls, suggesting an origin of adventure and life on the road. Wrapped around his neck at all times would be a snugly fit leather necklace with a silver pendant on it near his throat, in the shape of a pine tree.

A cocky, confident and pure gaze follows this man's soft blue eyes and long blonde hair. He is garbed in long Jedi robes, lightly armoured and pristine in condition. His smile could stun crowds, and he walks with the confidence that comes with such charm.
Anger filled this young Jedi, but harmony brought her down to earth and turned her into a kind and caring young lady with a genuine desire to make the lives around her better.
Master Nulaa Aldette, Jedi Guardian. Sacrificed herself in the line of duty to help bring about the final defeat of Darth Revan.
Master Keyan Zione. Fell in battle against Darth Revan.

The Jedi Temple Guards are a special sect of Jedi sworn to guardianship over not only the Order but over locales deemed sacred or integral to the balance of the Force. The sect is shrouded deep in mystery, its members leaving behind their past names and identities entirely to serve its cause as faceless defenders.

Beyond temple grounds, the activities of the Temple Guards are highly classified, but what few rumors the Jedi indulge in speak of everything from routine scouting, to spying and infiltration of potential enemies.
